description:
How do you beat someone who betrayed you? Marcus Aurelius, the Stoic emperor of Rome, faced the worst betrayal of his life, and his answer is the most powerful lesson in Stoicism you'll hear about revenge.

In 175 AD, a false rumor spread that the emperor was dead. Avidius Cassius, the general he trusted most, declared himself emperor, and half the empire followed him. Months later, a chest arrived holding the letters of everyone who had helped the rebellion. All Marcus had to do was open it. He threw it into the fire.

3 Stoic ways to beat someone who betrayed you:
I. Don't curse them
II. Don't watch their downfall
III. Don't open what you don't need to know

"The best way to avenge yourself is not to become like the wrongdoer." (Meditations 6.6)
